 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 14-08-2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. This case has been heard out of turn on the mentioning of the learned counsel for the petitioner as the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has to appear in the Recruitment for Bihar Police Constable (Advt. No. 01/2023) to be held on 21.08.2024.
3. The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence under Sections 406, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
4. The Photocopy of the admit card produced by the learned counsel for the petitioner is taken on record.
5. Call for a ligible up-to-date photocopy of the case diary and the report regarding the Criminal Antecedent of the petitioner in connection Cyber P.S. Case No. 01 of 2023 from Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.56255 of 2024(2) dt.14-08-2024 the concerned court below.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner is granted provisional bail till 21st of August, 2024.

Let the petitioner, above named, be released on Provisional bail till 21st of August, 2024 on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand)with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aurangabad/concerned Court below in connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 01 of 2023 subject to condition that:-
7(i).
After appearing in the said examination to be held on 21st of August, 2024, the petitioner will surrender in the Court below on 22nd of August, 2024.

If the petitioner fails to surrender on 22nd of August, 2024, the Superintendent of Police,
Aurangabad will take all steps for the arrest of the petitioner.

8. Let a copy of this order be communciated to the Superintendent of Police, Aurangabad through FAX for its compliance forthwith.
